text.en: Words are the building blocks of every sentence.

In Tamil grammar a சொல் (word) is classified into four kinds: பெயர்ச்சொல் (noun), வினைச்சொல் (verb), இடைச்சொல் (particle) and உரிச்சொல் (qualifier). Each has its own work in a sentence.
Words can also be single words (தனிமொழி), compound words (தொடர்மொழி) or words with parts (பொதுமொழி). Learning these helps in analysis and in writing correctly.
Practise by taking a sentence and naming each word's type. This textbook section is a general introduction; read the exact definitions in your book.
